From the art of storytelling with Himanshu Rai to exploring history and its many narratives with Amit Agarwal, Alfaaz 2026 brought us conversations that inspired curiosity and offered new ways of looking at the world.

Some stories begin with a pen. Some begin much earlier, with curiosity.

This Alfaaz, join us for an Author Talk with Himanshu Rai, bestselling novelist and storyteller, whose writing journey began at just fourteen.

From My Mute Girlfriend to I Am Always Here With You, his stories have found their way to readers across the country.

📅 4 October
🕒 2:30 PM
📍 L-3

Come listen to the stories behind the stories, and discover what goes into bringing a world to life on the page.

See you at Alfaaz!

What’s your favourite trope?

Some stories stay with us because of the worlds they create, while others win us over with the tropes we can never resist. From second chances and chosen ones to unreliable narrators, time loops, and sympathetic villains and many more…there’s a trope for every kind of reader.

Swipe through to discover some of our favourite books built around these unforgettable tropes, and maybe find your next addition to the TBR.
